source_locator: Clark County results page, election 2013 Municipal Primary (04/02/2013), Official Election Results, contest MAYOR OF NORTH LAS VEGAS, Total row 9,153
verification_note: The county official results for the 04/02/2013 primary show Lee, John 4,909 (53.63 percent), Buck, Shari 3,248 (35.49 percent), Hunter, Mike 537 and Belger, Sharon 459, total 9,153, all 87 of 87 precincts reporting. Lee received a majority. The 06/04/2013 general lists no mayoral contest for North Las Vegas. NRS 293C.175(5) states the current rule that a majority winner in the primary is declared elected; for 2013 this is inferred from the absence of a mayoral contest on the general ballot. UNRESOLVED: the official rule that a primary majority elected the mayor in this year could not be established. NRS 293C.175(5) is the current statute for category one or two cities with June even-year primaries and is not shown to govern a North Las Vegas April odd-year election; the charter text could not be opened.

verification_note: The county official results for the 04/04/2017 primary show Lee, John J. 6,724 (80.77 percent), Bouchard, Gary 849 and Taylor, DeQuincy 752, total 8,325, all 92 of 92 precincts reporting. Lee received a majority. The 06/13/2017 general lists no mayoral contest for North Las Vegas, so the primary decided the office. NRS 293C.175(5) states the current majority-elects rule; for 2017 it is inferred from the absence of a mayoral contest on the general ballot. UNRESOLVED: the official rule that a primary majority elected the mayor in this year could not be established. NRS 293C.175(5) is the current statute for category one or two cities with June even-year primaries and is not shown to govern a North Las Vegas April odd-year election; the charter text could not be opened.

verification_note: The county official results for the 11/08/2022 general show Goynes-Brown, Pamela A. 40,105 (65.71 percent) and Spearman, Pat 20,928 (34.29 percent), total 61,033. The 06/14/2022 nonpartisan primary had seven candidates and no majority winner (Goynes-Brown 9,762 of 26,448), so the top two advanced, as NRS 293C.175(5) provides.
